description: A project hexa has just made passes `hexa adr doctor`, because citations of hexa's own decisions resolve, and it ignores its build output and session state in `.gitignore`.

accepted.by: gary (run by Claude on gary's instruction)

specs.description: The build embeds the ids of hexa's own ADR files.
specs.given: a hexa source tree whose `docs/adrs/` holds `ADR-2609121400.md` and `ADR-2609211430.md`
specs.then: the binary's embedded hexa ledger is exactly {`ADR-2609121400`, `ADR-2609211430`}

specs.description: A build without hexa's ADR directory embeds no ids.
specs.given: a hexa source tree with no `docs/adrs/` directory
specs.then: the build succeeds and the embedded hexa ledger is empty

specs.description: Only files matching `ADR-*.md` count as decisions.
specs.then: the embedded hexa ledger is {`ADR-2609121400`} and has no entry for `README` or for `ADR-2609211430`

specs.description: An id in the project's ledger resolves to Project.
specs.then: it returns `CitedLedger::Project`

specs.description: An id that only hexa's ledger holds resolves to Hexa.
specs.then: it returns `CitedLedger::Hexa`

specs.description: An id that neither ledger holds is Dangling.
specs.then: it returns `CitedLedger::Dangling`

specs.description: The project's ledger takes precedence over hexa's.
specs.then: it returns `CitedLedger::Project`, not `CitedLedger::Hexa`

specs.description: With two empty ledgers, every id is Dangling.
specs.then: it returns `CitedLedger::Dangling`

specs.description: The doctor passes on a fresh project whose shipped files cite hexa's decisions.
specs.given: a project just made by `hexa dev new --lang rust`, whose `.hexa/ADR-rules.toml` and `/hexa-adr-create` skill cite `ADR-2609121400`, `ADR-2609211430`, `ADR-2609211600` and `ADR-2026-04-05-0900`, all of them in the embedded hexa ledger, and an empty project ledger
specs.then: it reports no `DanglingCitation` and exits successfully

specs.description: The doctor still reports a citation that resolves nowhere.
specs.given: a project whose own text cites `ADR-1999010100`, an id in neither the project's ledger nor the embedded hexa ledger
specs.then: it reports exactly one `DanglingCitation`, for `ADR-1999010100`, and fails, while in the same run a citation of one of hexa's own decisions in that project is not reported.

specs.description: A user's own citation of a hexa decision is not reported.
specs.given: a project ADR whose body cites `ADR-2609151930`, which the embedded hexa ledger holds and the project's ledger does not
specs.then: it reports no `DanglingCitation` for `ADR-2609151930`

specs.description: Resolution order holds over all inputs.
specs.given: any id, any project_ids and any hexa_ids
specs.then: it returns `Project` exactly when project_ids contains id; `Hexa` exactly when project_ids does not contain id and hexa_ids does; and `Dangling` exactly when neither contains id

specs.description: When the two ledgers are the same set, as in hexa's own repository, nothing goes unchecked.
specs.given: any id and any set of ids L, with project_ids = hexa_ids = L
specs.then: it never returns `Hexa`: it returns `Project` when L contains id and `Dangling` otherwise

specs.description: Rust ignores target/ and the session state.
specs.then: the result holds exactly `target/`, `.hexa/loop.json` and `.hexa/loop.lock`

specs.description: TS ignores node_modules/, dist/ and the session state.
specs.then: the result holds exactly `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `.hexa/loop.json` and `.hexa/loop.lock`

specs.description: Go adds no build-output lines, only the session state.
specs.then: the result holds exactly `.hexa/loop.json` and `.hexa/loop.lock`, and holds neither `target/` nor `node_modules/` nor `dist/`

specs.description: With no existing file, the merge gives every needed line.
specs.then: it returns Some(text) whose lines include `target/`, `.hexa/loop.json` and `.hexa/loop.lock`, each exactly once

specs.description: The merge keeps the existing text and appends only the missing lines.
specs.then: it returns Some(text) that begins with `*.log\ntarget/\n`, then holds `.hexa/loop.json` and `.hexa/loop.lock`, and holds `target/` only once

specs.description: Nothing is written when nothing is missing.
specs.then: it returns None

specs.description: A line counts as present only when it matches a whole line, not a substring.
specs.then: it returns Some(text) that appends `target/` as its own line

specs.description: `hexa dev new` writes the .gitignore, so the first commit holds no build output.
specs.when: `hexa dev new --lang rust` runs, then `cargo build`, then `git add -A`
specs.then: `.gitignore` holds `target/`, `.hexa/loop.json` and `.hexa/loop.lock`, and nothing under `target/` is staged

specs.description: `hexa init` leaves an already complete .gitignore unchanged.
specs.given: a directory whose `.gitignore` already holds every line `gitignore_lines("rust")` gives, along with other user lines
specs.then: `.gitignore` is byte-for-byte unchanged

specs.description: Every language ignores the session state.
specs.then: the result contains `.hexa/loop.json` and `.hexa/loop.lock`

specs.description: The merge is complete, preserving and duplicate-free.
specs.given: any existing text E (or None) and any lang among `rust`, `ts` and `go`
specs.then: text begins with E's content; every line of `gitignore_lines(lang)` is a whole line of text; and no line that `merged_gitignore` appended was already a whole line of E or appears more than once in what it appended

specs.description: The merge is idempotent.
specs.given: any existing text E (or None) and any lang among `rust`, `ts` and `go`
specs.when: `merged_gitignore(E, lang)` returns Some(text), and `merged_gitignore(Some(text), lang)` is then called
specs.then: the second call returns None

specs.description: None means nothing is missing.
specs.given: any existing text E (or None) and any lang among `rust`, `ts` and `go`
specs.then: it returns None exactly when E is Some and every line of `gitignore_lines(lang)` is already a whole line of E
